lines.speaker: Brokk the Unbroken
lines.text: Lost my hammer on Floor Seven. Some bastard bone construct took it. I forge with my hands now.

lines.speaker: Brokk the Unbroken
lines.text: Don't look at my fingers. I know they're missing. I use the other ones just fine.

lines.speaker: Brokk the Unbroken
lines.text: You want something forged, you bring me the materials. I don't work with junk.

lines.speaker: Brokk the Unbroken
lines.text: Get back in there. Come back with something worth my time.
